name: JSON Pretty Print with Tree View
summary: Format JSON with indentation and explore it in a collapsible tree view.
description: Paste minified or messy JSON to pretty-print it and browse keys, arrays, and values in an expandable tree alongside the formatted output.

faqs.question: Does this validate JSON?
faqs.answer: Yes — invalid JSON shows an error before formatting or building the tree.

faqs.question: Can I collapse nested objects?
faqs.answer: Click nodes in the tree to expand or collapse branches.
